data: What is the maximum degree shown for the Wikidata dataset?

The question asks for the maximum degree shown for the Wikidata dataset. From the caption, we know that the figure compares the degree distributions of the entity alignment datasets extracted by different methods. The x-axis represents the degree, and the y-axis represents the cumulative distribution. In the right subfigure labeled (b) Wikidata, the x-axis ranges from 0 to 40. Therefore, the maximum degree shown for the Wikidata dataset is 40.
